          <base href="/">

Sorry — we couldn't find that page.

```{=html}
<p id="suggestion" style="display: none;"></p>

<p>You can try one of these pages instead:</p>
<ul>
  <li><a href="index.html">Home</a></li>
  <li><a href="courses.html">Courses</a></li>
  <li><a href="course_content.html">Course content</a></li>
  <li><a href="resources.html">Resources</a></li>
  <li><a href="about_us.html">About us</a></li>
  <li><a href="contact.html">Contact</a></li>
</ul>

<script>
(function () {
  // Known pages on this site (basename without .html)
  const pages = [
    { slug: "index", href: "index.html", label: "Home" },
    { slug: "courses", href: "courses.html", label: "Courses" },
    { slug: "course_content", href: "course_content.html", label: "Course content" },
    { slug: "resources", href: "resources.html", label: "Resources" },
    { slug: "about_us", href: "about_us.html", label: "About us" },
    { slug: "contact", href: "contact.html", label: "Contact" }
  ];

  function levenshtein(a, b) {
    const m = a.length, n = b.length;
    const dp = Array.from({ length: m + 1 }, () => new Array(n + 1).fill(0));
    for (let i = 0; i <= m; i++) dp[i][0] = i;
    for (let j = 0; j <= n; j++) dp[0][j] = j;
    for (let i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
      for (let j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
        dp[i][j] = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1]
          ? dp[i - 1][j - 1]
          : 1 + Math.min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j - 1]);
      }
    }
    return dp[m][n];
  }

  // Path like /resouces.html or /resouces → "resouces"
  const path = window.location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, "");
  const requested = path.split("/").pop().replace(/\.html?$/i, "").toLowerCase();
  if (!requested || requested === "404") return;

  let best = null;
  let bestDist = Infinity;
  for (const page of pages) {
    const dist = levenshtein(requested, page.slug);
    if (dist < bestDist) {
      bestDist = dist;
      best = page;
    }
  }

  // Only suggest if it's a close typo (not a totally unrelated path)
  const maxDist = Math.max(2, Math.floor(best.slug.length / 3));
  if (best && bestDist > 0 && bestDist <= maxDist) {
    const el = document.getElementById("suggestion");
    el.style.display = "block";
    el.innerHTML =
      'Did you mean <a href="' + best.href + '"><strong>' + best.label +
      '</strong></a> (<code>' + best.href + '</code>)?';
  }
})();
</script>
```
